data.title: Semester Documents & Re-registration for Summer Semester 2027 – Hochschule Musterstadt
data.summary: Hochschule Musterstadt confirms Sam Rivera's re-registration for Winter Semester 2026/27 and encloses the enrollment certificate. Re-registration for Summer Semester 2027 requires paying the semester fee of 312.40 € so that it arrives by 15.01.2027; the letter also notes the Deutschlandsemesterticket will be included in the fee from Summer Semester 2027 onward.
data.explanation: Your enrollment for the current semester is confirmed and the certificate is attached. To stay enrolled for Summer Semester 2027, you must transfer the 312.40 € semester fee to the university's account by the stated deadline — re-registration only happens through this payment, not through a separate form. Paying late adds a 15 € late fee, and missing the deadline entirely risks being deregistered (Exmatrikulation) under NRW higher education law. If you already have a separate Deutschlandticket subscription, remember to cancel it before it becomes included in your semester fee, so you don't pay twice.
